ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: MarZlog uses the camera so you can take photos and attach them to your diary. For example, capture this moment and add it directly to today's entry.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MarZlog needs access to your photo library so you can select photos to create diary entries. For example, choose today's photos to generate an AI diary.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MarZlog saves photos to your library when you download images from your diary. For example, save a diary photo back to your camera roll.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: MarZlog uses Face ID to lock the app and keep your photos and diary entries private. For example, unlock the app with Face ID instead of entering your passcode.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MarZlog uses your location to tag where photos were taken in your diary. For example, your entry can show the place where you captured the moment.
